jsonSchema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 object; the runtime checks validity and rejects external or recursive $ref/$dynamicRef.

component.description: Closed component snapshot validated by cd80.capability/1 snapshot contract.

task.description: Skill step task passed to the frozen Skill runner.

AppDefinition.description: Canonical saved App definition. ZIP codeFile/resourceFiles and Python APP_INTERFACE are import transports and do not appear in saved definitions. Static issues may still require repair and verification before enablement.

testCases.description: Saved original task case first, followed by optional additional cases. A null expectation means an independent expected result is still required before verification.

AppDefinition.title: cd80.app/2 portable application definition

info.description: All requests require the current account session. Preview parses only; import stores an unverified, disabled private App. Verification and enablement are separate operations.
info.title: CD80 external App import API

testCases.description: Optional editable cases. When present, overrides package.definition.testCases without changing the package digest.

201.description: Created or idempotently replayed App detail; verification.status=unverified and enabledVersionId=null

post.summary: Save a normalized package as a private unverified, disabled App

200.description: Normalized portable package, definition, static issues, warnings, and owner-specific binding requirements

post.summary: Preview complete .json, .py or .zip without executing code or saving an App
Preview an existing cd80.app-package/2 JSON body

get.summary: Download source ZIP with app.json codeFile/resourceFiles

x-cd80-transport.canonical: cd80.app/2 JSON with embedded code/files and original testCases metadata, or cd80.app-package/2 with matching SHA-256 canonical digest

python.declaration: Exactly one top-level APP_INTERFACE static Python literal dict with name, description, inputSchema, outputSchema, rules; optional testCases.
python.entry: Exactly one top-level synchronous def run(payload). Source is parsed with AST but not imported or executed during preview/save.
python.inputSchema: type object, explicit properties and additionalProperties false; each property maps to an input binding.
python.mapping: One code node main; outputSchema becomes main.delivery.schema; outputs.result binds to the complete step result.

zip.codeFile: Only on a code node; relative UTF-8 source file; exclusive with code.
zip.entry: app.json or application.json at root or inside one wrapper directory
zip.pathRule: Forward-slash relative safe path. No traversal, symlink, duplicate casefold/NFC name, unreferenced file, encrypted entry, or path conflict.
zip.resourceFiles: Only on a code node; array of relative file paths. Each non-Finder ZIP member must be referenced exactly once. ZIP-only fields are replaced by canonical code and files.
